rules.name: ^Craftsman's Writ:
rules.text: Opened from a Sealed Journeyman's, Expert's or Artisan's Writ (enemies, treasure chests and dungeons drop them). Deliver the item it asks for: supply-faction reputation.
rules.src: icy-veins.com sealed writs; conquestcapped.com writs guide

rules.name: ^Sealed (Journeyman|Expert|Artisan)'s Writ
rules.text: Drops from enemies, treasure chests and dungeons; opens into one Craftsman's Writ of its rank.

rules.name: ^Scroll of (Imbue|Cryoblast|Greater Cryoblast|Frog Familiar|Cat Familiar|Rat Familiar|Khadgar|Minor Evocation|Confuse Beast|the Saber|Polymorph)
rules.text: A Mage deciphers it (Comprehend Scroll) from the undeciphered scrolls enemies drop anywhere; also in a Bundle of Scrolls (library Research).
rules.src: warcrafttavern.com mage scrolls; method.gg comprehension guide
